articles.title: OpenAI Announces GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Vision, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, which unifies text, vision, audio, and code generation into a single natively multimodal architecture rather than routing between specialized submodels. Benchmarks show a 35% improvement on SWE-Bench Verified over GPT-4o and significantly reduced hallucination rates. The model also introduces a persistent memory layer accessible across sessions via API, raising both capability and privacy considerations.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves Silver-Medal Level on International Math Olympiad 2026 Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind demonstrated Gemini Ultra 2 solving four of six IMO 2026 problems at a silver-medal standard, building on last year's AlphaProof results but now using a unified end-to-end language model without a separate formal proof verifier. The system leverages a novel chain-of-thought distillation method trained on millions of synthetic proof traces. This marks a significant step toward general mathematical reasoning without domain-specific symbolic scaffolding.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen-3 Begins Limited Deployment in Amazon Fulfillment Centers
articles.summary: Amazon confirmed a pilot deployment of approximately 1,000 Tesla Optimus Gen-3 humanoid robots across three fulfillment centers in Texas and Tennessee, handling bin-picking and shelf-stocking tasks. The robots use onboard vision-language models for zero-shot object manipulation, reportedly achieving 94% grasp success on novel items. The partnership signals accelerating convergence between humanoid robotics and large-scale warehouse logistics.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C as Its Humanoid Robot Demonstrates Autonomous Construction Tasks
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C at a $15 billion valuation after publicly demonstrating its Figure 03 robot performing multi-step construction tasks including drywall carrying, precision screw driving, and site navigation without teleoperation. The robot runs a transformer-based world model trained on thousands of hours of construction site video. The funding will be used to scale manufacturing and pursue contracts with major homebuilders facing persistent labor shortages.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional Classifiers for Real-Time Guardrails on Agentic AI Systems
articles.summary: Anthropic published a paper and released an open-weight safety classifier suite designed to monitor and constrain agentic AI systems operating autonomously over extended time horizons. The classifiers evaluate tool calls, code execution, and multi-step plans against configurable constitutional principles in real time with under 50ms latency overhead. The release addresses growing industry concern about deploying AI agents that browse the web, write code, and manage infrastructure with minimal human oversight.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm A14 Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced it has commenced high-volume manufacturing on its A14 (1.4nm-class) process node at its Kaohsiung fab, approximately one quarter ahead of the originally projected timeline. The node uses gate-all-around nanosheet transistors and backside power delivery to achieve a 20% speed improvement or 35% power reduction versus N2. Early customers are expected to include Apple, Nvidia, and AMD, with AI accelerator chips anticipated as the dominant initial workload.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Full Orion AR Glasses Software Stack, Announces Developer Edition Hardware
articles.summary: Meta released the complete software stack for its Orion AR glasses under a permissive open-source license and opened pre-orders for a $1,500 developer edition shipping in Q4 2026. The stack includes a neural interface SDK for EMG wristband input, a spatial AI framework for persistent world anchors, and integration with Llama 4 for contextual on-device assistance. The move positions Meta to build an open ecosystem ahead of Apple Vision Pro's more locked-down platform.

articles.title: Quantum Startup PsiQuantum Demonstrates First Fault-Tolerant Logical Qubit Operations in Photonic Architecture
articles.summary: PsiQuantum reported achieving fault-tolerant error correction with logical qubit error rates below the surface code threshold using its photonic quantum computing architecture at its GlobalFoundries-fabricated chip facility. The demonstration involved eight logical qubits performing repeated syndrome extraction cycles with error rates of approximately 0.1% per round. While still far from commercial advantage, this is the first photonic platform to reach the fault-tolerance milestone, validating a manufacturing-friendly path to large-scale quantum computing.
